static void
reorder_marks_arabic (const hb_ot_shape_plan_t *plan,
		      hb_buffer_t              *buffer,
		      unsigned int              start,
		      unsigned int              end)
{
  hb_glyph_info_t *info = buffer->out_info;
  unsigned int i = start;
  unsigned int j = start;

  for (; i < end; i++)
  {
    /* The following logic skips the Arabic script marks
     * which according to Unicode built-in shaping rules
     * are not allowed to affect the order of the base
     * glyphs. */
    if (unlikely (_hb_glyph_info_is_arabic_mark (info[i])))
    {
      unsigned int j = i;
      while (j + 1 < end && _hb_glyph_info_is_arabic_mark (info[j + 1]))
	j++;

      /* For each mark that is not a "medial" mark, we can
       * merge its cluster with the cluster of the preceding
       * base. */
      if (j > i && !_hb_glyph_info_is_arabic_medial_mark (info[i]))
      {
	unsigned int start = i;
	unsigned int cluster = info[i].cluster;
	while (start < j)
	{
	  cluster = MIN (cluster, info[start].cluster);
	  start++;
	}
	/* Merge clusters. */
	buffer->merge_out_clusters (i, j + 1);
      }

      i = j;
    }
  }
}
</END AGENT OBSERVATION>

static void
reorder_marks_arabic (const hb_ot_shape_plan_t *plan,
		      hb_buffer_t              *buffer,
		      unsigned int              start,
		      unsigned int              end)
{
  hb_glyph_info_t *info = buffer->out_info;
  unsigned int i = start;
  unsigned int j = start;

  for (; i < end; i++)
  {
    /* The following logic skips the Arabic script marks
     * which according to Unicode built-in shaping rules
     * are not allowed to affect the order of the base
     * glyphs. */
    if (unlikely (_hb_glyph_info_is_arabic_mark (info[i])))
    {
      unsigned int j = i;
      while (j + 1 < end && _hb_glyph_info_is_arabic_mark (info[j + 1]))
	j++;

      /* For each mark that is not a "medial" mark, we can
       * merge its cluster with the cluster of the preceding
       * base. */
      if (j > i && !_hb_glyph_info_is_arabic_medial_mark (info[i]))
      {
	unsigned int start = i;
	unsigned int cluster = info[i].cluster;
	while (start < j)
	{
	  cluster = MIN (cluster, info[start].cluster);
	  start++;
	}
	/* Merge clusters. */
	buffer->merge_out_clusters (i, j + 1);
      }

      i = j;
    }
  }
}

static void
_hb_ot_shape_normalize (const hb_ot_shape_plan_t *plan,
			hb_buffer_t              *buffer,
			hb_font_t                *font)
{
  if (unlikely (!buffer->len))
    return;

  hb_buffer_t *buffer2 = hb_buffer_create ();
  hb_buffer_set_unicode_funcs (buffer2, buffer->unicode);
  hb_buffer_set_direction (buffer2, buffer->direction);
  hb_buffer_set_script (buffer2, buffer->script);
  hb_buffer_set_language (buffer2, buffer->language);
  hb_buffer_set_flags (buffer2, buffer->flags);
  hb_buffer_set_cluster_level (buffer2, buffer->cluster_level);
  hb_buffer_set_replacement_codepoint (buffer2, buffer->replacement_codepoint);
  hb_buffer_set_invisible_glyph (buffer2, buffer->invisible_glyph);
  hb_buffer_set_not_found_glyph (buffer2, buffer->not_found_glyph);

  hb_ot_shape_normalize (plan, buffer, buffer2, font);

  hb_buffer_swap (buffer, buffer2);
  hb_buffer_destroy (buffer2);
}
